title: Add calculation history feature to track previous results

requirements.text: Display a calculation history section that shows a list of all previous calculations performed in the current session
acceptanceCriteria: History section is visible on the calculator interface
Each history entry shows the complete calculation (e.g., '5 + 3 = 8')
History persists during the current session
Most recent calculation appears at the top of the list

requirements.text: Update the calculation history automatically whenever a successful calculation is performed (add, subtract, multiply, or divide)
acceptanceCriteria: History updates immediately after each operation button click
Only successful calculations are added to history
Invalid input attempts do not create history entries
Division by zero errors do not create history entries

requirements.text: Add a clear history button that removes all entries from the calculation history
acceptanceCriteria: Clear button is clearly labeled and accessible
Clicking clear removes all history entries instantly
Clear button is disabled or hidden when history is empty
After clearing, the history section shows an appropriate empty state

requirements.text: Style the calculation history section consistently with the existing modern, minimalist design using the warm coral/orange color scheme
acceptanceCriteria: History section uses the same color palette as the calculator
Typography and spacing match existing design patterns
History entries are easy to read and well-organized

constraints: History should be stored in component state only (client-side, no backend persistence)
Do not modify the existing calculation logic or operation buttons
Maintain the current warm coral/orange color scheme avoiding blue and purple
Keep the modern, minimalist design style consistent
nonGoals: Persisting history across browser sessions or page refreshes
